Game Overview

Run Guys: The Chaos Race puts players into a adventure experience centered on embark on a whimsical journey across the USA, dodging, leaping, and launching past everyday obstacles. Race against others, escalating the fun with strategic moves. Experiment with new costumes and skins while navigating this chaotic, lively race. Every race promises unexpected thrills and laughter.
